title: Module review
subtitle: Everything from Food and Wine
objectives: Build a pairing for a dish

steps.prompt: Match each food element to its effect on wine.
steps.explanation: Sweetness, umami and chilli make wine harder; salt and acidity soften it.

steps.prompt: Which wine is best with a sweet dessert?
options: A wine at least as sweet as the dessert
steps.explanation: Sweet food makes dry wine taste thin and sour.

steps.prompt: High acidity and bubbles help cut through fried and fatty food.
steps.explanation: Yes. They work like a squeeze of lemon, refreshing the palate.

steps.prompt: Which wines suit a spicy curry?
steps.explanation: Aromatic, off-dry, lower-alcohol whites calm heat. Big, tannic, high-alcohol reds burn.

steps.prompt: When choosing a wine, focus on the sauce more than the ____.
steps.explanation: The sauce sets the dominant elements, like acid, fat or sweetness.

steps.title: What you learned
points: Sweetness and umami harden wine; salt and acidity soften it
Chilli needs lower alcohol and a touch of sugar
Match weight, then match or contrast the dominant elements
Tannin and fat, acidity and frying, sweet and salty work well together
